title: Optimized automatic ad and segment skipping
message: Faster early player detection, automatic clicks on supported Skip Ad controls, improved segment metadata matching and reduced mutation scanning overhead.
features: Immediate auto-click when supported Skip Ad controls become visible and enabled
Twelve configurable segment categories with SponsorBlock-style marker mapping
Cached settings, targeted mutation scans, per-element click throttling and animation-frame batching
Page ad cleanup remains separate from auto-skip toggle; no media/DRM manipulation
